summary.text: Rob Swearingen is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 34, who took office on January 7, 2013, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Merlin Van Buren.

paragraphs.text: Rob Swearingen won Assembly District 34 general elections in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, according to Ballotpedia.
For 2025-2026 he chairs the State Affairs Committee, is vice-chair of the Tourism Committee and also sits on the Forestry, Parks, and Outdoor Recreation Committee.
